xrefdescription.para: XS-01: storeDocument and getDocument round-trip.

detaileddescription.para: Stores a deterministic document and retrieves it by ID, verifying identity and field preservation.

xrefdescription.para: XS-02: getDocument returns nullopt for unknown ID.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that querying an ID that has never been stored returns std::nullopt (not an error throw).

xrefdescription.para: XS-03: Duplicate storeDocument throws std::runtime_error.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies the duplicate-ID guard is enforced and throws the expected exception type.

xrefdescription.para: XS-04: storeDocument with empty ID throws std::invalid_argument.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies the empty-ID guard is enforced before attempting storage.

xrefdescription.para: XS-05: removeDocument removes by ID; subsequent getDocument returns nullopt.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies clean removal and that removeDocument is a no-op for unknown IDs.

xrefdescription.para: XS-06: listByType returns only documents matching the requested type.

detaileddescription.para: Stores three documents with different object types and validates that listByType returns exactly the matching subset.

xrefdescription.para: XS-07: listByRetention returns only documents with the matching category.

detaileddescription.para: Stores documents with all three retention categories and verifies that listByRetention returns exactly the matching subset for each.

xrefdescription.para: XS-08: listChildren returns only direct children of the given parent ID.

detaileddescription.para: Stores a parent Akte and two children (one with parent set, one without), and verifies listChildren returns exactly the documents whose parent_id matches.

xrefdescription.para: XI-01: importFromXML V3.0 single-document success path.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that a well-formed single-document V3.0 XML is parsed into exactly one document with the correct ID, aktenzeichen, and version string.

xrefdescription.para: XI-02: importFromXML V2.1 single-document success path.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that a well-formed V2.1 XML produces xdomea_version = "2.1.0".

xrefdescription.para: XI-03: importFromXML parses both <akte> and <dokument> elements.

detaileddescription.para: A fixture with one <akte> and one <dokument> must produce two documents with the correct object_type assignments.

xrefdescription.para: XI-04: importFromXML persists parsed documents into the connector's store.

detaileddescription.para: After a successful import, documents must be retrievable by ID via getDocument().

xrefdescription.para: XI-05: importFromXML returns empty result for empty XML.

detaileddescription.para: An empty string must not crash; result must report success=false and zero documents.

xrefdescription.para: XI-06: importFromXML records an error for an unclosed <dokument> element.

detaileddescription.para: Unclosed element must not crash; result must contain at least one error and no successfully imported documents.

xrefdescription.para: XI-07: importFromXML handles XML with no document elements gracefully.

detaileddescription.para: Valid XML with no <dokument> or <akte> tags must produce an empty document list without error.

xrefdescription.para: XI-08: importFromXML assigns fallback ID when <id> element is absent.

detaileddescription.para: Documents without an explicit <id> element must receive a generated ID (not empty) so they can be stored and retrieved.

xrefdescription.para: XE-01: exportToXML V3.0 produces valid envelope with correct version attribute.

detaileddescription.para: The exported XML must contain the xdomea:version="3.0.0" attribute and the correct nachrichtentyp code for ERFASSUNG (0601).

xrefdescription.para: XE-02: exportToXML V2.1 produces correct version attribute.

detaileddescription.para: The exported XML must contain the xdomea:version="2.1.0" attribute.

xrefdescription.para: XE-03: exportToXML includes document ID in the XML output.

detaileddescription.para: The document's ID field must appear in the serialized output so a downstream importer can re-identify it.

xrefdescription.para: XE-04: exportToXML escapes reserved XML characters in betreff.

detaileddescription.para: A betreff containing <, >, &, ' and " must be safely escaped in the XML output so the result is well-formed.

xrefdescription.para: XE-05: exportToXML produces the correct nachrichtentyp code for AUSSONDERUNG.

detaileddescription.para: Validates that the message-type code mapping is applied correctly for a non-default message type.

xrefdescription.para: XE-06: exportToXML empty document list produces valid empty envelope.

detaileddescription.para: An empty document vector must produce a valid XML envelope without error and with zero documents exported.

xrefdescription.para: XMV-01: V1 and V2 schema versions are registered without conflict.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies that registeredVersions() returns both versions in ascending order.

xrefdescription.para: XMV-02: Document body valid against schema v1 passes validation.

detaileddescription.para: A JSON body containing only the required v1 fields must validate cleanly against schema version 1.

xrefdescription.para: XMV-03: Document body missing optional field validates against v2.

detaileddescription.para: A body with the required fields but without the optional aktenzeichen field must still pass schema v2 validation (optional = no violation).

xrefdescription.para: XMV-04: Stored XDOMEA document coexists with schema-validated document body.

detaileddescription.para: Verifies the complete multi-version lifecycle: import an XDOMEA document, persist it in the connector, construct a parallel JSON body for schema validation, and confirm both layers agree on the canonical ID.
This test models the expected integration pattern where an XDOMEA exchange layer and the schema evolution registry operate independently on the same logical document.

briefdescription.para: XDOMEA connector and multi-version document deterministic fixture tests.

detaileddescription.para: Covers three test categories addressing Phase 4 roadmap item: "extend deterministic fixture coverage for XDOMEA and multi-version document cases"

listitem.para: XDOMEAImport (XI-01 … XI-08): importFromXML V2.1 / V3.0 parsing edge cases
XDOMEAExport (XE-01 … XE-06): exportToXML serialization and message types
XDOMEAMultiVersion (XMV-01 … XMV-04): multi-version document lifecycle with schema evolution registry

detaileddescription.para: All tests use deterministic fixtures with kXDOMEACanonicalSeed = 42 where randomness is needed. No external XML library dependency is assumed; the InMemoryXDOMEAConnector's minimal scanner is exercised directly.

simplesect.para: Target: Q4 2026 hardening sprint — Phase 4 XDOMEA closure
